notes: Tolerances are half the precision the example prints, value by value, except k. For k the checker computes 0.37080 from unrounded modular ratios. The example prints 0.3709, from its own rounded intermediate products. The k tolerance of 0.001 is an allowance for that, stated here rather than hidden. ffe is the capped FRP stress Ef times efd. The example prints it at a trial depth. The cap makes it the same value at the converged depth.
source: Numbers printed in the Simpson Strong-Tie worked example named in input.json. A value the example does not print is not listed here.

trial.note: First trial state printed in the example at c = 6 in. Tolerances are half the printed precision.
